mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts above 850k units and retail sales above $420 billion indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 420000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 99.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces real economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns during manufacturing slowdown regimes over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index exceeding 230.0 signals accelerating inflation that increases monetary tightening risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 850k units signals strong residential construction that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth above 135k and unemployment decline below 7.7% indicates labor market strengthening that increases consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 7.7.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 99.5 indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days during industrial contraction regimes.
